name: Code Embedding Service
description: Serves CodeSage-Large-v2 code embeddings (2048-dim, Apache-2.0, sentence-transformers; HTTP on port 11440 unless its CODE_EMBED_PORT setting says otherwise). Used only by code graphs whose selected model is CodeSage; jina-v2-base-code and qwen3-embedding code graphs are embedded by Ollama directly, not by this service. In VCO's own install it is the code_embed container (infrastructure/docker-compose.yml), started on GPU hosts.

settings.description: gpu = CodeSage via sentence-transformers (needs 3GB VRAM); ollama = the service only proxies the install tier's Ollama code model (no CodeSage) - code graphs on such hosts are embedded by Ollama directly. Chosen at install time.
cuda / mps / cpu. Leave empty for auto-detect.

health_check._note: {code_embed_port} is the port the launcher resolves for the service (docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md section 15): its row in the launcher.db service_endpoints table, else 11440 - CODE_EMBED_PORT's default in claude_mcp_servers/code_embedding_service/server.py, infrastructure/docker-compose.yml and the setting above. The same row feeds CODE_EMBED_PORT in every project's env, so the hub's health poller (vct-hub src/module_health.rs) probes the port the service was moved to (Services page, Move to another port). Pinned by bundled_manifests::tests::code_embedding_manifest_names_the_services_real_default_port and project_env_settings::tests::code_embedding_health_url_is_the_resolvers_default. It once said 11438, a port nothing serves.

_model_note: No CODE_EMBED_MODEL pin (v0.2.102 W6-B2): the service derives its model from CODE_EMBED_BACKEND (claude_mcp_servers/code_embedding_service/server.py: gpu -> codesage/codesage-large-v2, ollama -> an Ollama-served model), so this runtime can never pair a backend with a model it cannot serve. VCO's own container gets the install tier's model through the compose env file install writes (vco_lib/compose_env.py code_embed_service_model).
_mcp_note: Not an MCP — it's an HTTP service the weaviate-kg MCP calls internally.
